name: SQE Encounter Gate
justification: See docs/reports/sonarqube-analysis.md section 'Quality gate'. Conditions are on OVERALL code (not new code) so the gate is evaluated on every analysis of the scoped encounter modules.

conditions.meaning: fail if Reliability rating is worse than A (any bug)
fail if Security rating is worse than A (any vulnerability)
fail if Maintainability rating is worse than A (debt ratio > 5%)
fail if more than 3% of lines are duplicated

fail if backend line+branch coverage of the scoped modules drops below 75% (measured 76.8% on 28 Nov 2026; regression ratchet - business-rule functions are separately held at 100% by testing/mutation/coverage_quality_gate.py)
